source_message.text:
Current status: the site layout has been fully recovered, Wordfence has been configured for security, malware has been removed from around 34 outdated plugins, and all fake admins have been removed.

Follow-up work remains. Although the pages appear fine, I cannot verify whether all the private pages work correctly. Please test every contact form and change your admin password. For the search-engine cleanup, I still need Search Console access for Stonefield as well.

**Overall report**
There are signs of earlier, smaller-scale attacks dating back to 2022. The majority of the 14000 posts were injected on October 14th, and all of the website's pages were deleted on December 20th.
